posts.author: Andar
posts.body:
Please try to follow the terms used in the RPG Makers as that prevents a lot of confusion.
I can't see your picture (not even if I follow the link to imgur), but from the description I can already say that you looked for the wrong term.
What you describe is mostly a message system or a GUI, it has nothing to do with scripts (which is a term of programming (as in script code) in the RM community.
Message type plugins are much easier to do than anything that would have been called script system in the community, and if you only want to change the battle user interface that is also a lot simpler (not easy or simple in itself, but a lot easier than script frameworks)
you might want to search the forum and especially the plugin/script lists for those terms (message system or battle system) and you might even find someone already did that.
